messages:
frank: FYI postmortem follow-up: saw a canary cert rotation in eu-central trigger a short routing thrash + client retries -> spike in 504s. starting checklist.
maya: can you paste the client error spikes? quick view would help.
frank: pasted below
frank: ```
2026-03-22T22:03:12Z client 10.2.5.7 -> lb-euc: connect timeout
2026-03-22T22:03:13Z lb-euc -> backend-c healthcheck 200 but cert CN mismatch
2026-03-22T22:03:13Z clients retrying -> increase 502/504 count
```
li: looks like the canary job swapped backends before certs finished propagating to sidecars. also saw kube-proxy conntrack evictions around same window.
noah: i traced the LB logs. traffic flipped to a new routing table for ~18s then bounced back. retries amplified the burst.
maya: mitigation suggestions: a) gate canary switch on cert-ready signal b) increase probe interval during rotation c) add jitter to client retries
frank: agree. temporary actions: set canary wait-for-cert flag, bump probe interval from 2s -> 8s for rotation window, and deploy client retry cap of 3 attempts.
li: i'll own the cert-ready gating change in the deployment orchestrator. ETA: 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC. @li
noah: i'll open infra PR for probe interval + client retry cap. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/498
maya: i'll create a dashboard for canary rotation metrics: cert age on sidecars, routing flips, and retry amplification. will add alert: routing flips > 5 in 10m.
oncall: infra-bot scheduled a maintenance window for 2026-03-24 02:00-03:00 UTC. will page if apply fails.
infra-bot: deploy job queued -> id: dq-2198. will post status here when complete.
frank: owners & deadlines:
- li: cert-ready gating in orchestrator  ETA 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC
- noah: PR for probe/retry config and rollout plan  ETA 2026-03-23 18:00 UTC
- maya: dashboards/alerts + runbook snippet  ETA 2026-03-24 12:00 UTC
- oncall: coordinate maintenance + verify post-deploy health  ETA 2026-03-24 04:00 UTC
frank: pattern note: similar minor spikes seen 2026-01-12 and 2026-02-05 during canaries. adding recurring-canary-risk review to postmortem doc.
maya: linked previous incidents in the doc and added timeline.
noah: PR opened -> added rollback plan and feature-flag to revert probe changes quickly.
li: deployed gating to staging, tests green. will promote to canary during maintain window.
infra-bot: deploy dq-2198 started at 2026-03-24T02:07:00Z
infra-bot: deploy dq-2198 succeeded at 2026-03-24T02:12:34Z
oncall: verified canary metrics after apply, no routing flips observed, alert stable.
frank: leaving postmortem follow-up sync for 2026-03-26 10:00 PT to confirm actions closed. update the doc when done. thanks all.
